svg.text: talk.01 · ROUND 8 · ONE LAYOUT, FOUR SKINS
squeeze strip on the right · roller in a pocket on the left · a glowing window shows the mode · colour and grille are the variables
TENTATIVE · NOT A FINAL DESIGN
original concepts · same scale (10 mm = 40 px) · the strip is drawn popped out; dashed = flush
Not borrowed: the rugged yellow walkie's bumper and military look. Borrowed: the roller in a pocket, the 7-dimple grille, the glowing window, the cut corner.
1 · EMBER
gunmetal + orange glow
reference: the dark gadget: 7-dimple speaker, glowing screw-
cornered window, ribbed roller in a pocket, a cut corner
grille: seven dimples, each a tiny cluster of holes (the
centre one is the mic)
mode: the window glows amber, red, green or off; four dots
beside the roller
+ the closest to the TE feel; the glowing window is the hero
- all-dark looks serious; the glow needs a real diffuser;
dimples are fiddly to print
2 · SAND
beige + teal
reference: the beige cassette deck and boombox (beige with
teal); the round-6 and round-7 layout
grille: horizontal lines in a teal frame
mode: the window glows amber, teal, green or off
+ the softest and friendliest; matches the retro palette you
like
- the least bold; the window colour must stay readable on
beige
3 · POPPY
cream + red
reference: the Walkman and the toy radio; red as the one
loud colour on cream
grille: vertical slots
mode: the window glows red, orange, green or off
+ the most eye-catching at a glance; a clear hero colour
- a strong red can feel toy-like; the cut corner needs care
at the thumb
4 · SAGE
sage + black + orange
reference: the dot-matrix cube and the olive hand radio,
softened to sage
grille: a dot-matrix field
mode: the window glows lime, amber, red or off
+ calm and unusual; sage with black and orange is
distinctive
- sage may print greyish; the dot field needs 0.8 mm holes
